# Zamera — Extended Product & Privacy Knowledge Bundle (v0.1.7+8)
> Zamera — 100% On-Device True-Color Artwork Camera, Pro DSLR & Unified Cinema Video Studio by Akarworks.

## 1. Canonical Overview
Zamera is a cross-platform true-color photography, manual DSLR camera, and unified cinema video application developed by Akarworks for iOS 17.0+ and Android 10+. Engineered for 100% offline processing, zero telemetry, and 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness, Zamera unifies four studio modes inside one app: Art Mode calibration with a 24-patch ColorChecker CIEDE2000 solver (targeting Delta E00 <= 1.0), manual PASM exposure with 1/3-EV stops, 14-bit Bayer RAW and Apple ProRAW capture, computational Portrait bokeh, and 180-degree shutter-locked 10-bit Pro Video (Rec.709, Apple Log, ProRes 422 HQ, HLG10). Version 0.1.7+8 delivers hardened StoreKit 2 / Google Play Billing lifecycle verification, bilingual TR/EN support, rust FFI safety, and a 30-day free trial for Zamera Pro alongside daily free TrueColor/RAW/Sticker quotas with zero cloud uploads. Zamera preserves full local KVKK, GDPR, and CCPA privacy with zero third-party trackers.

## 2. Privacy & Data Safety Guarantees
- Zero Data Collection: Zamera collects zero photos, videos, audio, location, telemetry, usage analytics, or device advertising identifiers.
- Offline Color & AI Pipelines: Embedded Rust `zamera_core` CIEDE2000 math, Android on-device ML Kit Subject/Selfie Segmentation + LiteRT/U2-Net cutout, and Apple Vision segmentation execute on user device hardware without uploading user media.
- Minimal Permissions: Camera, Microphone (strictly during Pro Video mode), and local Media Storage (for saving DNG/JPEG/PNG/video files to DCIM/Zamera or Apple Photos).
- Regulatory Alignment: Fully aligned with KVKK (Turkey Law No. 6698), EU GDPR, and California CCPA via zero external data transmission.
- Zero-Telemetry Storefront Billing: Zamera Pro entitlements are processed exclusively through native Apple StoreKit 2 and Google Play Billing without third-party monetization trackers (no RevenueCat/Adapty).

## 3. Hybrid Freemium Model (1-Month Free Trial + Lifetime)
- Free Tier: Hardware Probe, standard JPEG/HEIF Pro Photo, Portrait mode, 4K/1080p Rec.709 Pro Video, live TrueColor A/B comparison, Sticker checkerboard preview, and daily free quotas (1 TrueColor capture, 1 DNG RAW capture/export, and 3 transparent PNG sticker exports per day).
- Zamera Pro Plans:
  - Annual Pro: $19.99/year (₺449.99/year) with a **1-Month (30-Day) Free Trial**.
  - Lifetime Pro: $34.99 launch / $49.99 regular (₺799.99 launch / ₺1,199.99 regular) one-time purchase.
  - Monthly Pro: $3.99/month (₺99.99/month) flexible anchor plan.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions
### What is Zamera and who is it for?
Zamera is built by Akarworks for artists, photographers, archivists, and mobile cinematographers who need calibrated color accuracy, full manual hardware control, transparent subject cutouts, and strict offline privacy.

### Does Zamera upload photos or stickers to any server?
No. All photos, RAW DNG files, videos, calibration profiles, and transparent PNG stickers remain strictly local on your device until you explicitly choose Share or Copy.

### Does Zamera Pro use third-party analytics or payment tracking SDKs?
No. Zamera uses Apple StoreKit 2 and Google Play Billing directly on-device so subscription status and daily quota counts remain private without external servers.
